requirement: Map an add-dosage command to a new Dosage model: copy the antibiotic ID, route of administration, dose text, and optional CrCl range by reference, let the entity generate its ID, and always report success.

preconditions.text: The mapper is constructed without dependencies

inputs.text: Oral standard dose with no CrCl range
Intravenous adjusted dose with a 15-29 mL/min CrCl range

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with a new Dosage
Antibiotic ID, route, and dose are copied and a generated non-empty ID is assigned
The CrCl range is carried over with its min/max flags and unit intact; null stays null

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
